semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides environmental protection equipment crucial for semiconductor manufacturing facilities.
summary: Chiyo Enterprises Limited specializes in environmental protection equipment for the treatment of waste gases, including greenhouse and toxic gases, generated during semiconductor manufacturing. They offer comprehensive solutions that integrate technology development, equipment manufacturing, and engineering contracting to help control environmental pollution and support sustainable practices in the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Waste gas treatment systems for semiconductor manufacturing
